_note: Latest posts from @luxseamiami, scraped 2026-08-17 with apify/instagram-scraper. Instagram's CDN urls are signed and expire within days, so the images are downloaded and served from assets/media/ — never hotlinked. Re-run fetch-instagram.py after a fresh scrape to refresh. 'alt' is written by looking at each downloaded image, not from the caption: the captions are marketing copy, not descriptions.
